steps.python_approach: pd.read_csv(csv_path) keeping RangeIndex; apply make.names to column names; for every string column (pd.api.types.is_string_dtype) strip one pair of surrounding single quotes as R does. Never sort/reset_index.

steps.r_construct: pmin caps on ClaimNb (4) and Exposure (1)
steps.python_approach: Series.clip(upper=...) in the R order, before any feature derivation.

steps.r_construct: as.integer(factor(Area)); as.factor(pmin(VehPower, 9)); lookup-table recodes for VehAge and DrivAge; relevel(); pmin(BonusMalus,150); log(Density); relevel(as.factor(VehBrand/Region)); as.factor(VehGas)
steps.python_approach: AreaGLM = 1-based position of Area in its sorted unique levels; VehPowerGLM, VehAgeGLM, DrivAgeGLM kept as level strings built with explicit numpy lookup arrays (positional column 2 of the lookup matrix = class code); out-of-table values become NaN. BonusMalusGLM = clip(150); DensityGLM = np.log(Density). Factor reference levels come from meta.json xlevels (first level = reference).

design_matrix(df): '(Intercept)' column of 1.0 first, then for each formula term in order either the numeric column or explicit 0/1 dummies '<var><level>' for every non-reference level in captured xlevels; unknown levels / NA -> NaN row. Columns == TERMS.
Not re-implemented. fit() uses only the rows it is given (frozen R split from the harness).

steps.r_construct: glm(..., family = poisson(), offset = log(Exposure)), na.action = na.omit
steps.python_approach: Numpy IRLS mirroring glm.fit: mustart = y + 0.1, eta = log(mustart), z = eta - offset + (y-mu)/mu, w = sqrt(mu), QR least squares, linkinv pmax(exp(eta), DBL_EPSILON), stopping rule |dev-devold|/(|dev|+0.1) < 1e-8, maxit 25; SEs from the R factor of the last iteration's weighted QR (dispersion 1). Rows incomplete in any formula variable, response or Exposure are dropped before fitting.
exp(X @ beta + log(Exposure)) with X from the same design_matrix; NaN wherever any input is missing, never imputed.
